recipes.name: The Coagulator inspired by The Simpsons
ingredients: 3 (5 oz) cans albacore tuna, packed in water
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 1/2 cups water, plus more if needed
instructions: For For the Babish Version:
For the Mayonnaise

In a tall, narrow container that is the same width as an immersion blender, add the egg, Dijon mustard, lemon, garlic and salt. - 1 whole egg - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - ½ lemon - 1 garlic clove microplaned - kosher salt to taste
Insert the immersion blender and blend for 30 seconds, or until the eggs and mustard are fully combined.

Slowly pour the oil down the sides of the container so it rests just on top of the egg yolk mixture, then blend constantly from the bottom of the mixture to the top of the mixture until it forms a thick mayonnaise. - 1 cup neutral oil
Taste and adjust with more salt, if needed. Transfer to a resealable container and refrigerate until ready to use. - For the Mayonnaise
For the Fancy Tuna Salad
Wrap the tuna in a clean tea towel or several layered paper towels. Squeeze as much excess water as possible out of the tuna. - 3 (5 oz) cans albacore tuna packed in water

Transfer the tuna to a mixing bowl and add the mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, celery, chives, salt and pepper. - 1 cup homemade mayonnaise - 2 tbsp Dijon mustard - 1 celery rib finely chopped - 1 tbsp chives finely chopped - kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste - 3 (5 oz) cans albacore tuna packed in water
Mix together until fully incorporated, then taste and season with additional salt and pepper, if needed. - For the Fancy Tuna Salad
For the Tuna Melt
On one slice of sourdough, spread a layer of the Fancy Tuna Salad, then top with the shaved Red Leicester cheese. - 1 sourdough bread - Fancy Tuna Salad - Red Leicester cheese thinly shaved
Arrange the top slice on the tuna, so that no tuna salad drapes over the edges. Wrap in plastic wrap and let rest in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
For the Pakora Batter

In a large mixing bowl, whisk all the ingredients together until homogenous. - 3 cups chickpea flour - 1 teaspoon kosher salt - 1 tsp garlic powder optional - 1 tsp Old Bay seasoning optional - 1 ½ cups water plus more if needed
For the Frying
In a Dutch Oven over medium heat, add 2 inches of vegetable oil and preheat to 350°F. - vegetable oil

Remove the tuna melt from the fridge and unwrap. Then, drench the entire tuna melt in the Pakora Batter, then lower the battered sandwich into the preheated vegetable oil. - Tuna Melt - For the Pakora Batter
Agitate using a kitchen spider and fry for 5 to 7 minutes, maintaining a temperature between 325°F to 350°F. Fry slowly and low ensuring the sandwich is heated all the way through. - Tuna Melt
Remove from the oil once golden brown and drain on a wire cooling rack set over a rimmed baking sheet. - Tuna Melt
Let cool for 5 minutes, slice, and enjoy.
For For the Simpsons Version:
For the Mayonnaise Vegetable Oil Mixture

Add the mayonnaise and vegetable oil to a large, deep pot. Be sure the pot is completely off before beginning. The slower the mayonnaise can heat up, the less likely it will burn. - 2 cups mayonnaise - vegetable oil for frying
Completely liquefy the mayonnaise on low heat. Allow the mixture to slightly cool.
Line a fine mesh sieve with cheesecloth set over a large Dutch oven. Carefully pour the mayonnaise mixture through the cheesecloth, discarding any solids.
Return the mayonnaise mixture back to the large, deep pot. Over medium heat, preheat the oil to 375°F when ready to fry.
For the Tuna Melt

Spread mayonnaise on the bread, then layer on the American cheese slices before scooping on a layer of Premade Deli Tuna Salad. - mayo - 2 slices sourdough bread - 4 slices American cheese - Premade Deli Tuna Salad
Arrange the top slice on the tuna, so that no tuna salad drapes over the edges. Wrap in plastic wrap and let rest in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
For the Funnel Cake Batter

In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, powdered sugar, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. - 3 cups (390 g) all purpose flour - ¼ cup powdered sugar - 4 tsp baking powder - 1 ½ tsp kosher salt - ¼ tsp cinnamon
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vanilla extract. - 4 eggs - 2 cups whole milk - 2 tsp vanilla extract
Add the wet ingredients to the dry and gently fold the two together until mostly smooth, some lumps are okay.
For the Funnel Cake Frying (optional)
Drizzle the batter in circles into 350°F oil in a large, high-walled pot using a spider, flipping occasionally for even frying.
Remove from the oil once golden brown and drain on a wire cooling rack set over a rimmed baking sheet.
Dust with sifted powdered sugar. - powdered sugar to tas
For the Assembly
Remove the tuna melt from the fridge and unwrap. Then, drench the entire tuna melt in the Funnel Cake Batter, then lower the battered sandwich in the fat rendered from the mayonnaise mixture.
Very very carefully, lower the battered tuna melt into the preheated clarified mayonnaise fat.
Agitate using a kitchen spider and fry for 5 to 7 minutes, maintaining a temperature between 325°F to 350°F. Fry slowly and low ensuring the sandwich is heated all the way through.
Remove from the oil once golden brown and drain on a wire cooling rack set over a rimmed baking sheet.
Once cool, dust with sifted powdered sugar. - powdered sugar to tas
Not recommended.
